newsitem.title: USA: De Rigo Group Q1 sales fall by 29.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: De Rigo Group Q1 sales fall by 29.8 percent.

text.p: De Rigo Group said 1997 first quarter net sales fell by 29.8 percent, to 65.4 billion lire, from the 93.2 billion lire it reported last year.
The Italian sunglasses maker said first quarter net direct sales fell by 30.5 percent to 62.9 billion lire.

The company attributed the decline mainly to a delay in shipments of orders received, related to the setup of an automated integrated management information system, which came on line in January 1997. It said the decline is evenly spread throughout all markets, with the exception of the United States market, which has performed better than others.
